Land-surface elevation profile of a line within Fort Ethan Allen, Alexandria Co. [now Arlington], Va.

Land-surface elevation profile of a line within Fort Ethan Allen, Alexandria Co. [now Arlington], Va. Pen-and-ink (black) and lead pencil. At lower right in handwriting: Transferred from Office of Chf. Engr., Defenses of Washington, to Engr. Dept. Jan'y 1866. Imperfect: Fold-lined, rubber-stamped on verso. Drawn in 2 segments. Includes 2 strait-line diagrams of measurement points along the profile. At upper edge: 211, L., sheet 17. Library of Congress.
